scope.nativeChecks: The existing result's mechanical PASS is reused, not rerun. The independent pixel verdict is based on the four actual image opens.

questions.question: Was PASS inferred from the producer result rather than actual pixels?
questions.answer: No. All four original full-page screenshots were opened once and inspected across their entire height; the result was a bound reference, not a substitute for visual evidence.

questions.question: Could the lower paragraphs or inline formulas be clipped while the top of the page looked acceptable?
questions.answer: The final liquid-resistance content and footer are visible in every image. Pi, omega-zero and omega-equals-omega-zero are visibly intact, including mobile line wraps. No clipping or incoherent overlap was found.

questions.question: Are the two figures clear without reopening or creating crops?
questions.answer: Yes. Both complete panels are visible in every supplied image. Axis labels and symbols are readable; the peak and guide are distinct, and the three numbered curves and leaders can be distinguished at the recorded desktop and mobile sizes.

questions.question: Does the displayed order have a content reference, including captions and section separators?
questions.answer: Yes. The stored native HTML text and finalized lesson prose were read as references. Definition, footnote, captions, energy discussion, damping comparison and final paragraphs appear in the supplied order, with the three prescribed visual separators.

questions.question: Does this review reopen completed D059 stages or source307 work?
questions.answer: No. Those independent PASS stages remain closed. Figure observations concern display clarity only, not source reconstruction, science or translation correctness.

questions.question: Are delivery bindings exact and current, and was other work preserved?
questions.answer: Yes. All bound input hashes still match the result; the report has exactly the same four screenshot path strings. Only the two requested files in the owned D060 directory were created.
